label: OPEN: a harmed competent person has their own valid directed claim against gratuitous injury
paraphrase: OPEN stronger, specifically victim-directed bridge: under the augmented nonconsensual, unjustified, gratuitous-injury case with a feasible alternative, an affected second-personally competent person personally has legitimate standing to demand that this accountable offender refrain from deliberately harming them, irrespective of the offender's ends. It is stronger than merely there being some accountable community or third-party claimant. Darwall's general equal-standing proposal does not by itself establish that this particular anti-injury claim lies within the victim's authority; the standing and content warrants are independently OPEN. Non-competent victims' claims require an additional patienthood or representation account, not reclassification as competent.
